mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies at Fireman's Park with a temperature of 64 degrees. If you look up tonight at 8:27 PM, keep your eyes peeled for the International Space Station appearing over Verona High School and heading toward the Madison area near Home Depot for a four minute flyover. We are expecting an overnight low of 61 degrees and rain is in the forecast.
Public works will begin chip sealing road treatments on September 23. This work will impact Cross Country Road and East Verona Avenue, so please expect lane closures and use caution in those areas.

There is plenty to do in our area. Today, you can enjoy live music at Bailey's Run. Tomorrow, the town will be buzzing with the Sugar River Fire and Smoke BBQ Festival in Paoli and the Saturday Farmers Market at the Capitol.
Regarding recent activity, on September 3, a 33-year-old Madison man was arrested for O W I second offence after crashing his vehicle on Shooting Star Road.
While we know it is a local favorite, Culver's is currently closed for remodeling, so today's flavor of the day is unavailable.
